fact: The document refers to Uganda's National Broadband Policy 2018 as a policy under implementation, which the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and the ITU reviewed; it gives no end date or replacement, and the year 2018 is taken from the policy's title.

The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and the ITU published a review of the implementation of the 2018 National Broadband Policy, with a matrix of each objective and strategy, activities undertaken, outcomes, reported level of implementation by stakeholders, challenges and mitigation measures; the document is dated by its published date, 2026-01-12, and states no figures in the excerpt.
